runuser -u postgres -- psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "INSERT INTO public.replication_evidence(marker) VALUES ('streaming-ok-after-all-restarts') ON CONFLICT (marker) DO UPDATE SET committed_at=clock_timestamp();"
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  n=$(runuser -u postgres -- psql -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_replication WHERE state='streaming' AND replay_lsn >= pg_current_wal_lsn();")
  [ "$n" = "2" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
[ "$n" = "2" ]
printf 'primary_final='
runuser -u postgres -- psql -Atc "SELECT pg_is_in_recovery(),current_setting('transaction_read_only'),marker FROM public.replication_evidence WHERE marker='streaming-ok-after-all-restarts';"

runuser -u postgres -- psql -Atc "SELECT application_name,client_addr,state,sync_state,sent_lsn,flush_lsn,replay_lsn FROM pg_stat_replication ORDER BY application_name;"
